metadata.title: Monge-Ampère degenerations and conifold contractions in Fujiki class $\mathcal{C}$
metadata.abstract: Given a $\mathbb{Q}$-Gorenstein normal projective Calabi-Yau variety $Y$ with ordinary double points as singularities and a small crepant resolution $\pi\colon X\to Y$ with $X$ in the Fujiki class $\mathcal{C}$, we establish uniform estimates away from the exceptional locus where the given metrics may degenerate. When $Y$ is a threefold, we prove that these metrics also converge in a Gromov-Hausdorff sense to the metric completion of $Y$ on the regular locus. In particular, our results extend the work of Song on a conjecture of Candelas and de la Ossa.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: Fujiki 类中的 conifold 收缩
analysis.workSummary: 对有普通双点的 Q-Gorenstein 正规射影 Calabi–Yau 簇及 Fujiki 类小 crepant 解，建立退化度量在例外集外的一致估计；三维时证明 Gromov–Hausdorff 收敛到正则部分的度量完备化。
analysis.breakthrough: 把 conifold 收缩的度量收敛结果推进到指定 Fujiki 类解空间。
analysis.limitations: GH 收敛部分限三维；目标奇点、射影性和小 crepant 解条件不能省略。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 AI 工具用于检查证明的常规步骤及改进表述。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 AI 工具用于检查证明的常规步骤及改进表述。
